import numpy as np
import cvxpy as cp


def run_case_1():
    x = cp.Variable(3)
    hypos = cp.Variable(2)
    # Objective and constraints from description: “PowConeND(W,hypos,alpha,axis=1)”
    W = cp.bmat([[x[0], x[2]], [x[1], 1.0]])
    alpha = np.array([[0.2, 0.4], [0.8, 0.6]])
    prob = cp.Problem(cp.Max(cp.sum(hypos) - x[0]),
                        [x[0] + x[2] + 0.5 * x[1] == 2,
                         PowConeND(W, hypos, alpha, axis=1)])
    prob.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL)
    return prob.value, x.value, hypos.value

    x = cp.Variable(3)
    hypos = cp.Variable(2)
    axis_list = [0, 1]
    alpha = [[0.2, 0.4], [0.8, 0.6]]
    W = cp.bmat([[x[0], x[1]], [x[2], 1.0]])

    results = []
    for axis in axis_list:
        constraints = [
            x[0] + x[2] + 0.5 * x[1] == 2,
            PowConeND(W, hypos, alpha, axis=axis),
        ]
        prob = cp.Problem(cp.Max(cp.sum(hypos) - x[0]), constraints)
        res = prob.solve(solver=cp.CLARABEL)
        results.append((axis, prob.status, res, x.value, hypos.value))
    return results
